description: Search file CONTENTS by regex, recursively. Per file returns path, rev, line count, then matching line numbers with their text. Long lines are clipped around the match (max_line_length, default 200). Line numbers and rev feed straight into read_text_file offset/limit and edit_file line edits. Documents (PDF, Word, spreadsheets…) are searched in their extracted text: matches as L<n> (p.N / slide N / sheet Name), no rev; documents:false skips them. Other binaries and symlinks are skipped; output is capped and flags truncation when incomplete. To find files by name use search_files.
name: grep_files
title: Search file contents
